title: Introduce per-tenant residency-policy-evaluator and compact audit envelope
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: enterprise customers requested a lightweight, verifiable residency decision path that runs inside the private installer control plane and enforces KMS region constraints at bind-time, while also reducing audit payload surface for downstream storage. This PR adds a per-tenant Residency Decision Evaluator (RDE) that consumes claim assertions from service principals, verifies KMS key metadata against configured residency policies, and returns a deterministic allow/deny decision. To reduce PII and token bloat in long-term audit stores we introduce a compact audit envelope format: canonicalized event header + hashed sensitive attributes + optional encrypted payload pointer.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds a new control-plane component: installer/residency-evaluator (Go) that implements policy evaluation and a small in-memory cache for decisions with TTL and evict metrics.
- Introduces RBAC v2 role residency.evaluator and RBAC binding glue so operator accounts can invoke policy queries without needing full kms:Decrypt scope.
- KMS integration: verifier fetches KMS key metadata (region/provider) via existing kms-proxy client and validates it against tenant residency config. Fallback rules allow multi-provider key aliases when operators opt in.
- Audit changes: new compact envelope serializer in installer/pkg/audit that emits compacted events for matches labeled "residency-compact". Compact envelope contains event_id, timestamp, policy_id, decision_hash, and an encrypted blob reference when full context is needed.
- CLI & config: installer config schema updated (config/residency.yaml) with policy DSL, grace windows, and cache TTL. Installer CLI gains --residency-mode flag to opt into enforcement vs advisory.
- Tests: unit tests for policy matcher, integration test that spins up a local kms-proxy stub, and e2e test in private-installer/test/fixtures that exercises a tenant onboarding flow with residency enforcement.
- Docs: docs/ops/residency.md with rollout steps and migration notes.

Why this approach: running enforcement in the private installer keeps decision latency low and audit evidence colocated with the installation lifecycle events. Compact audit envelopes address long-term retention costs and PII constraints by defaulting to hashed identifiers while allowing operators to unlock the full context via an encrypted pointer when required for forensic workflows.

Backward compatibility & rollout: default mode is advisory. Operators must opt into enforcement via --residency-mode=enforce. RBAC role addition is additive and will not change existing access semantics unless bindings are applied. Migration path documented in docs/ops/residency.md.

Testing & CI: unit suite (pkg/residency/*, pkg/audit/*) + integration (tests/integration/residency) added. Local runs flagged one lint failure (unused var in audit compactor) which was fixed; final CI run: all checks green.

Release notes: Adds a Residency Decision Evaluator and a compact audit envelope format. Enforcement is opt-in. See docs/ops/residency.md for configuration and rollback instructions.

review_thread: Ravi Patel (2026-02-20): Please add Prometheus counters for decision cache hits/misses and a gauge for cache size. We need visibility if this cache will cause OOMs in long-lived control planes.
Maya Chen (2026-02-21): Added cache metrics (cache_hits_total, cache_misses_total, cache_entries) and a configurable max_entries param. Updated Makefile to build metrics binary in test harness.

Elena Gomez (2026-02-24): The RBAC role 'residency.evaluator' looks good. Can we avoid granting kms:DescribeKey to the role? The estimator should use the kms-proxy read-only metadata endpoint instead.
Maya Chen (2026-02-25): Switched verifier to kms-proxy metadata endpoint; no additional kms permissions required. Updated docs to call out that operator bindings should not include kms:Decrypt.
Samir Khan (2026-02-26): Integration test flaked on first run due to a timing assumption in the e2e test. Recommend adding a retry with backoff to the tenant-onboard step.

Maya Chen (2026-02-27): Added retry/backoff and increased test timeouts. Re-ran CI — initial pipeline had a lint failure (unused variable in compact_envelope.go), fixed and re-pushed. Final CI run: green.
Elena Gomez (2026-02-28): LGTM after docs update. Approving.
Ravi Patel (2026-03-01): Approved and left a suggestive comment to add a governance example for multi-provider keys in the docs. Not blocking.
notes_on_rollback: Because enforcement is opt-in, rollback is a configuration change: set --residency-mode=advisory and remove residency.evaluator bindings if applied. Audit envelopes already written in compact mode can be expanded only if operators have the encrypted blob key; otherwise treat as immutable hashed evidence.
release_notes: Add: Residency Decision Evaluator (opt-in enforcement) and a compact audit envelope format; Add: RBAC role residency.evaluator; Change: CLI flag --residency-mode to control enforcement vs advisory
